assets.name: premium-slot-chains
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent locking chain overlay sprite for Sylve, a premium hand-painted woodland fantasy card game.
Primary request: two thick dark forged-iron chains crossing diagonally in an X, joined at their center by a magnificent CLOSED GOLDEN PADLOCK. The padlock is warm antique gold, carved with a simple oak leaf relief, with one small glowing emerald inset above the unmistakable black keyhole. The chain links are dark iron with warm gold fittings nearest the lock. It must clearly communicate an exclusive chest slot bought with emeralds.
Style/medium: polished detailed painterly 2D storybook fantasy game art, tactile worn metal, warm upper-left lantern highlights, deep charcoal-green shadows, strong broad clear silhouette readable at 120 pixels.
Composition: square canvas, orthographic frontal view. Four chain arms extend toward all four corners, centered substantial gold padlock; entire isolated X-shaped silhouette fits within canvas with a small clear margin. Separate links with transparent space in their holes.
Constraints: genuinely alpha-transparent background around the sprite and between every link. Only the crossed chain and closed golden padlock. No chest, no box, no panel, no scenery, no floor, no frame, no text, no digits, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no painted checkerboard.

assets.name: chest-key-1
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one isolated golden key illustration for a purchase card in Sylve, a premium hand-painted 2D woodland fantasy card game.
Primary request: one beautiful antique GOLD KEY that unlocks a treasure chest slot. A round open bow shaped from two curving oak leaves, one small emerald inset at the top of the bow, a solid straight golden shaft and a broad traditional two-tooth bit. This is the first key: simple and welcoming, tactile rich honey gold with fine leaf engravings, dark amber edges and restrained mint reflections in the tiny gem.
Composition: square canvas, a SINGLE key diagonally rising from lower left (bit) to upper right (bow), whole key visible, fills 80 percent of the canvas with generous clear margin. Broad readable silhouette at 150 pixels. Near-frontal view with a little metal depth.
Style: polished painterly 2D storybook fantasy game art, warm upper-left light, restrained material glints, matching walnut treasure chests and an emerald forest sanctuary.
Constraints: genuine alpha-transparent background. Exactly one whole gold key. No second key, no chain, no chest, no scenery, no floor, no pedestal, no shadow plane, no frame, no UI, no text, no letters, no digits, no logo, no watermark, no sparkles outside silhouette.
